title: Suvartha Mosina Padamulu – Sayaram Gattu Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ఏ లేమికి కలత చెందరు, ఏ నలతకు తలలు వంచరు
ప్రభు సేవలో ధీరులు వీరు, తన చిత్తము ఎరిగిన వారు
english: Ey lemiki kalatha chendharu, ey nalathaku thalalu vancharu
prabhu sevalo dheerulu veeru, thana chittham erigina vaaru
intro: Suvartha Mosina Padamulu is the latest Christian Telugu song written and tuned by Bro. Sayaram Gattu, sung by Telugu Christian Gospel Singer Lillyan Christopher and music composed by renowned Telugu christian music director, J K Christopher. This song was released on August 15, 2020 through Sayaram Gattu Youtube Channel.
